comment: The league's sponsors. Each one shows on /sponsors/, in the 'Supported by' strip on the home page and in the footer. Nothing shows while the list is empty. Put logos in src/assets/img/sponsors/ (PNG, WebP or SVG, ideally a dark logo on a transparent background: it sits on a white tile). Fields: name (required), url (their website), logo, role (short label, e.g. 'Kit sponsor' or 'Awards night partner'), blurb (one or two sentences for the sponsors page). Order = display order.

example.name: Example Studio
example.blurb: One or two sentences about who they are and what they do for the league.
